consensus_summary: Faith centrally means trusting reliance on God and Christ, especially regarding salvation and divine promises, rather than mere intellectual assent; many consensus readings also regard genuine faith as productive of faithfulness and obedience.
book_summary: Faith is steadfast reliance on God’s unseen promise that takes living form through obedience, combining trust with fidelity and action.
consensus_core_identification: Trusting reliance on God or Christ and confidence in divine promises.
book_core_identification: Steadfast, obedient trusting reliance on God’s unseen promise.
boundary_disagreement: The book makes steadfastness and obedient enactment part of its identification of living faith. It therefore excludes or reclassifies cases of inward belief or professed trust that do not persist or issue in obedience, whereas the minimal consensus core can identify trust as faith while treating works as its necessary fruit rather than part of the definition.
material_contradiction: There is no replacement of the consensus referent: both identify faith as reliance on God. The limited tension concerns whether obedience helps constitute living faith or merely follows from genuine faith, especially alongside the common Protestant formula that faith alone is the instrument of justification.
rationale: The book retains the settled center of the blind consensus—trust in God and his promises—but sharpens it through the recognized faithfulness and living-faith strands. Because those strands appear among the consensus responses and alternatives, the entry is neither novel nor divergent. The added requirement of persevering, obedient expression creates a meaningful narrower boundary, making REFINED more appropriate than MATCH.
strongest_objection: A MATCH classification is plausible because several consensus responses already define faith as trust expressed through commitment and obedience, and James 2 is repeatedly used to distinguish living faith from mere assent. On that reading, the book only compresses established nuances rather than materially narrowing the category.
